scenes.en: On screens, you blink far less.
scenes.say: When did you last blink? If you're on a screen, probably not for a while.

scenes.en: Each blink spreads fresh tears that keep your eyes clear and comfortable.
scenes.say: Every blink spreads a fresh layer of tears across your eye. It keeps the surface smooth, clear and comfortable.

scenes.en: Studies show we blink much less on screens, and often only half-way.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show we blink much less while staring at screens, and many blinks only close half way. So eyes feel dry, gritty and tired.

scenes.en: Close gently, pause 2 seconds, squeeze softly, open. Repeat 10 times.
scenes.ta: மெதுவாக மூடி, 2 வினாடி நிறுத்தி, திறக்கவும் – 10 முறை
scenes.say: Do this blink exercise. Close your eyes gently. Pause for two seconds. Squeeze softly, then open. Repeat ten times, a few times a day.

scenes.en: Every 20 minutes, look far away. A cool, clean cloth can soothe tired eyes.
scenes.say: Do rest your eyes. Every twenty minutes, look far away. A cool, clean cloth over closed eyes can feel soothing.

scenes.en: Don't rub your eyes. Don't let a fan or AC blow on your face.
scenes.ta: கண்ணைத் தேய்க்காதீர்கள், முகத்தில் நேராகக் காற்று வேண்டாம்
scenes.say: Don't rub your eyes. Don't let a fan or AC blow straight on your face. And don't use random eye drops without advice.

scenes.en: Pain, redness, light sensitivity or blur that doesn't clear.
scenes.ta: வலி, சிவப்பு, மங்கல் இருந்தால் உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if you have eye pain, redness, sensitivity to light, or blur that doesn't clear when you blink.
Dry, tired eyes every day? Book an eye test.
